ruleDefinitions.name: Delete Important Scheduled Task
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when adversaries stop services or processes by deleting their respective scheduled tasks in order to conduct data destructive activities

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/delete.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/tn.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\BitLocker.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\ExploitGuard.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\SystemRestore\\\\SR.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\UpdateOrchestrator\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\WindowsBackup\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\WindowsUpdate\\\\.*")))
